featured_reviews.review_text:
My Google Review # 000434

Raymond doesn’t disappoint. That too, since the last 30yrs for me.

Now, the good news is that Raymond has opened up 5 stores here in Oberoi Skycity and this comes as blessing for us, who had to earlier drive for 20 kms to Oberoi Goregaon to get a decent male garment pick.

The Ready to Wear outlet is on the 2nd floor @ Skycity. The store area is big and houses all the possible choices for a gentleman’s formal dressing. A good variety of office suits, three pieces, party blazers, loaded types of shirts, formal trousers, pure leather belts, jackets are available to choose from. The staff is courteous and well mannered, just like you expect in any other Raymond store across Bharat. There are also some early bird discounts at this store which you can get if you are lucky, as the store has recently opened up.

Just one point was not good, that few shirts were being manufactured from Bangladesh which I do not appreciate at all. I hope the Raymond Management will take note of this.

All types of payments accepted here – UPI, cash, debit cards, credit cards. Plenty of parking available in the mall.
